Recommended with in a discounted price from booking.com | Liked: The buffet breakfast was good, offered a nice variety, and was reasonably priced. There were more than 20 items to choose from, including both local and continental options. Overall, it was a satisfying breakfast experience and provided good value for money. | Disliked: Overall, I had a good stay, and the hotel offers good value for the price, especially if you book through Booking.com with a discount.

The rooms are decent, clean, and nicely decorated. They include a small refrigerator and a 32-inch TV. The washroom was also in good condition. However, I did notice some dust under the bed while looking for a piece of paper, so housekeeping could pay a bit more attention to areas that are not immediately visible.

The food was good and reasonably priced. The buffet breakfast was one of the highlights, offering more than 20 items with a good variety, making it excellent value for money.

There are a few areas that need improvement. The behavior of some staff members, particularly at the front desk, could be more welcoming and professional. I also found the breakfast manager to be less professional than expected.

The swimming pool was a bit disappointing. It is located on the ground floor, quite small, receives very little sunlight, and the water was noticeably cold, which made it less enjoyable.

Overall, despite a few shortcomings, the hotel provides a comfortable stay at a budget-friendly price. If you can get a discounted rate through Booking.com, I would recommend it for travelers looking for good value rather than luxury.
